params.body:
Pins the gateway to v0.45.0: the run lifecycle (#133), the review request retried until GitHub lists the reviewer (#134), loosening a lifecycle held to the owner (#136), and `lifecycle` served as a grant field (#137).

`control-gateway-linux-amd64` of the v0.45.0 release hashes to `c7481e8dffd40f29eae116e3a1ed29cdeefe1068c7865762912b1e7d8b50e6a3`. That matches SHA256SUMS, and I checked it against the downloaded asset. The tag is on ff81d4e, the merge of #137.

Once this runs, the gateway announces `lifecycle` among its fields. Elixir (#249) then writes the workbench lifecycle into the next policy version and signs it itself, since adding a lifecycle is narrower. From that version on, every workbench run is judged under it.

The gateway runs v0.45.0 only after the configuration is carried and the VM is stopped and started.
params.title: The gateway runs v0.45.0
